Pertubuhan Doktor Khatan Malaysia (MADOC: The Malaysian Doctor of Circumcision Society (MADOCS) was founded on the conviction that safe circumcision practice requires continuous knowledge, training and guidance. The society stands on three pillars: structured education, quality clinical training, and knowledge sharing among medical practitioners across the country.
The Malaysian Doctor of Circumcision Society (MADOCS) is a professional association that brings together doctors involved in the practice, education and training of circumcision in Malaysia.

The Malaysian Doctor of Circumcision Society (MADOCS) is a professional association that raises the standards of safe circumcision practice through education, training, advocacy and professional collaboration.

The Malaysian Doctor of Circumcision Society (MADOCS) is a professional body registered with the Registrar of Societies Malaysia. MADOCS brings together doctors involved in circumcision practice with the aim of raising clinical standards, patient safety and the quality of training.
The Malaysian Doctor of Circumcision Society (MADOCS) advances safe circumcision practice through education, structured clinical training and professional development of doctors in Malaysia.
